name: Kartu Kredit Danamon JCB Precious

memberLevels.name: Dana kelolaan Rp 50 juta or more
memberLevels.condition: total funds under management at Danamon in the previous month of Rp 50.000.000 or more

memberLevels.name: Dana kelolaan under Rp 50 juta
memberLevels.condition: total funds under management at Danamon in the previous month below Rp 50.000.000

notes: The rate follows total dana kelolaan at Danamon in the previous month: Rp 50.000.000 or more earns 3x D-Point per Rp 2.500, below it 2,5x. Both need the month's accumulated retail transactions to reach Rp 1.500.000, and the uplift then applies across the whole month, not only the spend above the floor.

The RIPLAY states the 3x and 2,5x multiples but never the figure they multiply. A base of 1 D-Point per Rp 2.500 is taken from the wording "3x D-Point untuk setiap transaksi ritel Rp2.500" and from secondary reporting, and is what the card earns below the Rp 1.500.000 floor. Worth checking against a statement.

The uplift is capped at whichever is smaller: retail transactions of one times the card limit, including a temporary limit, or Rp 300.000.000 a month. The Rp 300.000.000 ceiling is in the entry; the card limit is read from the card's own terms when the entry is applied, so set the credit limit before relying on the estimate.
8.000 D-Point once a month at Rp 10.000.000 of accumulated transactions, with no multiples for spending more.

Earning excludes insurance payments, cash advance, money transfer, balance conversion, QRIS funded by this card, any transaction converted to an instalment together with the monthly instalment charges, and cancelled transactions. Insurance is matched by category; the rest are matched on the words an issuer usually puts on the statement line, so a differently worded description will be missed and overestimated.
The card requires total dana kelolaan of at least Rp 50.000.000 to be issued, so the lower level applies to a holder whose balance has since fallen rather than to a new applicant.
Not modelled: the 5% cashback up to Rp 100.000 a month on routine bill payments, which needs at least five retail transactions of Rp 100.000 or more, and airport lounge access. Neither pays D-Point.
The card limit runs from Rp 15.000.000 to Rp 1.000.000.000.

Taken from Danamon's own RIPLAY, the 26 August 2025 version, which gives no start date for the D-Point terms, so they are recorded as one open period. Secondary reporting describes a later devaluation and a clarification; neither was available here, so if the terms have since moved this entry is behind.
Rounding is taken as per full increment of Rp 2.500; the RIPLAY does not say how a part increment is treated.
